title: 第23章 天龙商会奉为上宾第24章 喜极而泣品质更高
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“啊？你怎么知道？”
“魂师？是什么？”
林馨儿闻言，满脸诧异。
她跟在朱大师身边，听到对方提过灵魂力量，说的是很神秘。
哪怕朱大师是二阶炼丹师，对灵魂力量的了解，也仅仅是皮毛。
林晨怎么说自己天生就具备灵魂力量呢？
没等来林晨的回答。
两人已经来到天元镇的核心地段，人声鼎沸，喧闹异常。
就见到正中间的地方，矗立着一座金碧辉煌的三层楼的阁楼。
阁楼的正前方挂着一块黄金雕刻的牌匾，上面雕刻着四个大字“天龙商会”
，牌匾的四个角落，则是用黄金镌刻四条小金龙。
整个阁楼四边，矗立着四根红木打造的柱子，房顶则是镶嵌清一色的琉璃瓦。
“晨弟，我们来天龙商会做什么？”
林馨儿来到天龙商会的大门外，都是吓一跳。
“待会你就知道了。”
林晨率先大摇大摆朝着里面走去。
“哟？林晨，你都无法开脉，来天龙商会干嘛呢？”
两人刚进入天龙商会，就见到不远处一个尖嘴猴腮的青年男子，他面色阴沉，双眸深处闪烁过杀意。
此人是刘振，算得上是刘家未来的中流砥柱之一。
他的年龄比刘建还要大上不少，已经二十二三岁。

修为也已经突破到融血境五重，算得上是天元镇青年一辈的天才之一。
林晨平静的瞥了一眼，眉头微微一凝。
倒是没想到来天龙商会，也能够遇见刘家之人。
他懒得理会刘振，迈开脚步就要朝着天龙商会里面走去。
“小子，别以为一剑斩杀刘柯，你就是天才。”
“刘柯本就是个纨绔子弟，杀他不足为傲。”
“况且，你那一剑，也不过是偷袭而已。”
刘振见到林晨小小年纪，竟然胆敢无视自己。
当即满脸愠怒，一步踏出，速度很快，就挡住林晨的去路。
自从林晨一剑斩杀刘柯后。
很多人都分析。
当时的情况，林晨就是趁刘柯不留神，才能够一剑斩杀刘柯。
整个天元镇，从来没有出现过，未开脉的武者，斩杀开脉境九重的存在。
“你们刘家的人，怎么总是阴魂不散呢？”
林晨略微皱起眉头，神色平淡的盯着对面的刘振，内心深处弥漫着冰冷的杀意。
他在天元镇生活了十六年，实在是懒得理会刘家的挑衅。
在他看来。
整个刘家都是蝼蚁而已，弹指间就可以覆灭。
偏偏。
content_en:
"Ah? How do you know?"
"Soul Master? What is it?"
When Lin Xiner heard this, her face was full of surprise.
She followed Master Zhu and heard him mention soul power, which was very mysterious.
Even if Master Zhu is a second-level alchemist, his understanding of soul power is only superficial.
How did Lin Chen say that he was born with soul power?
Lin Chen didn't wait for his answer.
The two of them had arrived at the core area of ​​Tianyuan Town, and it was very noisy and crowded.
In the middle, there stood a magnificent three-story attic.
Right in front of the attic hangs a gold-engraved plaque with the four characters "Tianlong Chamber of Commerce" engraved on it.
, the four corners of the plaque are engraved with four small golden dragons in gold.
There are four mahogany pillars standing on all four sides of the entire attic, and the roof is inlaid with all-color glazed tiles.
"Brother Chen, what are we doing at Tianlong Chamber of Commerce?"
Lin Xiner was shocked when she came outside the gate of Tianlong Chamber of Commerce.
"You'll find out later."
Lin Chen took the lead and walked swaggering inside.
"Hey? Lin Chen, you can't even open your pulse, why are you here at the Tianlong Chamber of Commerce?"
As soon as the two entered the Tianlong Chamber of Commerce, they saw a young man with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks not far away. His face was gloomy, and murderous intent flashed deep in his eyes.
This person is Liu Zhen, who can be regarded as one of the future mainstays of the Liu family.
He is much older than Liu Jian, already twenty-two or three years old.
His cultivation has also broken through to the fifth level of the Blood Fusion Realm, and he can be regarded as one of the young geniuses in Tianyuan Town.
Lin Chen glanced calmly and frowned slightly.
I didn't expect to meet people from the Liu family when I came to the Tianlong Chamber of Commerce.
He was too lazy to pay attention to Liu Zhen, and walked towards the Tianlong Chamber of Commerce.
"Boy, don't think that you are a genius if you kill Liu Ke with one sword."
"Liu Ke is just a playboy. Killing him is nothing to be proud of."
"Besides, your sword was just a sneak attack."
Liu Zhen saw that Lin Chen dared to ignore him at such a young age.
Immediately with a sullen face on his face, he took a step forward very quickly, blocking Lin Chen's way.
Ever since Lin Chen killed Liu Ke with one sword.
Many people analyze.
In the situation at that time, Lin Chen was able to kill Liu Ke with one sword while Liu Ke was not paying attention.
In the entire Tianyuan Town, there has never been a warrior who has not opened his veins and killed a person at the ninth level of the pulse opening realm.
"Why are you Liu family members always haunted?"
Lin Chen frowned slightly and stared at Liu Zhen opposite him with a calm expression, filled with cold murderous intent deep in his heart.
He had lived in Tianyuan Town for sixteen years and was too lazy to pay attention to the Liu family's provocation.
In his opinion.
The entire Liu family is just ants and can be destroyed with a snap of a finger.
Exactly.
